name: Web Jogmania
description: Jogmania is an exercise platform powered by iOS + Apple Watch capture and a FastAPI gamification engine. The web app is a user portal for runs, routes, and adventure replays (not a game). - `repo/apps/web` — Next.js + Tailwind web portal - `repo/apps/ios` — Expo React Native iOS app - `repo/api` — FastAPI backend + Ale.
